## CodeQL / Disabled Spring CSRF protection

CSRF vulnerability due to protection being disabled.

[Show more details](https://github.com/Corwin-Code/marketops-platform/security/code-scanning/66)

Assessment evidence for CodeQL #66 (alert remains OPEN):

The console is stateless and bearer-only; cookie, query, form and servlet-session inputs cannot authenticate. SignedBearerIdentityIT tests those refusals, hostile-Origin refusal, and a valid signed mutation without CSRF/cookie. Maintenance independently checks the actual loopback peer, operator attribution and disabled-by-default write switch. Introducing ambient cookie/session authentication requires reassessment.

Evidence is committed at `d4bc5fe51605501da4ebc18c89c5d47ec8dc5ed0` in `docs/07-phase-evidence/SLICE-V1-001/rework-r1/codeql-disposition.md`. Full regression 143 passes 846 unit/architecture and 374 integration tests; focused run 141 includes the relevant refusal and transport cases. Exact C3 verification is also being recorded separately.

No dismissal or thread resolution is performed by this reply. The remote security-state mutation requires explicit additional Human Owner authorization. This is a narrow source assessment, not a Controller closure verdict or a security-rule exclusion.

## CodeQL / Missing enum case in switch

Switch statement does not have a case for [UNKNOWN_STATE](1).

[Show more details](https://github.com/Corwin-Code/marketops-platform/security/code-scanning/68)

Correction evidence for CodeQL alert #68:

APPLY now has its own explicit UNKNOWN_STATE arm, separate from TIMEOUT. It preserves an unknown outcome and requires readback; it does not repeat a possibly executed write. PriceCommandWorkerIT and PriceWriteClassificationTest cover the transition.

Published in `6e44ed49de90e55b4558f1c0b76229d257729511`. Full backend runs 134 and 136 each pass 845 unit/architecture + 373 integration tests; all 11 required C1 CI contexts pass. CodeQL reports this alert fixed and the thread is already resolved. Evidence: `docs/07-phase-evidence/SLICE-V1-001/rework-r1/codeql-disposition.md` and `full-backend-134/`.

This records machine-review remediation only; no Frozen Finding or Controller acceptance is self-approved.

## CodeQL / Empty password in configuration file

Empty password in configuration file.

[Show more details](https://github.com/Corwin-Code/marketops-platform/security/code-scanning/73)

Assessment evidence for CodeQL #73 (alert remains OPEN):

The production profile explicitly disables in-app Flyway. Its inactive empty password override clears the mandatory inherited migration-secret placeholder; the application receives only the application-role secret. ApplicationConfigurationTest.rolesAreSeparated verifies the separation. The standalone migration artifact independently requires its credential and attestation envelope. No empty-password migration connection is intended or enabled by this property.

Evidence is committed at `d4bc5fe51605501da4ebc18c89c5d47ec8dc5ed0` in `docs/07-phase-evidence/SLICE-V1-001/rework-r1/codeql-disposition.md`. Full regression 143 passes 846 unit/architecture and 374 integration tests; focused run 141 includes the relevant refusal and transport cases. Exact C3 verification is also being recorded separately.

## CodeQL / User-controlled bypass of sensitive method

Sensitive method may not be executed depending on a [this condition](1), which flows from [user-controlled value](2).
Sensitive method may not be executed depending on a [this condition](3), which flows from [user-controlled value](2).

[Show more details](https://github.com/Corwin-Code/marketops-platform/security/code-scanning/75)

Assessment evidence for CodeQL #75 (alert remains OPEN):

The invalid-part guard throws and returns no data. Every returning path checks the stored requester/organization, live store scope and DB authorization before storage I/O, and reauthorizes after I/O. DiagnosticExportIT tests invalid/foreign/revoked/expired/corrupt requests and mid-read revocation. This guard does not grant access by skipping a check.

## CodeQL / User-controlled bypass of sensitive method

Sensitive method may not be executed depending on a [this condition](1), which flows from [user-controlled value](2).
Sensitive method may not be executed depending on a [this condition](3), which flows from [user-controlled value](2).

[Show more details](https://github.com/Corwin-Code/marketops-platform/security/code-scanning/76)

Assessment evidence for CodeQL #76 (alert remains OPEN):

The integrity guard throws and returns no bytes on length/hash mismatch. Returning bytes requires requester/organization/scope and DB authorization before I/O, then DB reauthorization after integrity verification. DiagnosticExportIT verifies corrupt/expired content and revocation during object read. Successful-download auditing remains after integrity verification so a refused corrupt part is not logged as downloaded.

## CodeQL / Cross-site scripting

Cross-site scripting vulnerability due to a [user-provided value](1).
Cross-site scripting vulnerability due to a [user-provided value](2).
Cross-site scripting vulnerability due to a [user-provided value](3).

[Show more details](https://github.com/Corwin-Code/marketops-platform/security/code-scanning/74)

Assessment evidence for CodeQL #74 (alert remains OPEN):

The reported setEntity call belongs to Apache HttpUriRequestBase: it constructs an outgoing HTTP request, not a browser response. Escaping the body as HTML would change approved provider bytes and their digest. BoundedOutboundHttpTest.outgoingRequestEntityPreservesExactBytesIncludingMarkup observes exact bytes over a local transport-only fixture; production prepare still rejects HTTP/loopback, private destinations and unapproved headers/redirects.

Evidence is committed at `d4bc5fe51605501da4ebc18c89c5d47ec8dc5ed0` in `docs/07-phase-evidence/SLICE-V1-001/rework-r1/codeql-disposition.md`.
